serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: Sand Solutions Government Cloud (SGC2) provides U.S.-based, managed cloud infrastructure and platform services for organizations with regulated workloads. The offering supports customer-specific hosted environments with infrastructure administration and optional managed services, subject to the documented SGC2 authorization boundary and customer service agreements. Available capabilities may include compute, networking, storage, operating system administration, database administration, monitoring, backup, and recovery. Customer responsibilities and the scope of managed services are established for each deployment.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: The Sand Solutions Government Cloud (SGC2) Trust Center provides authorized parties with access to SGC2 authorization and continuous monitoring documentation, along with information on how Sand Solutions secures and operates SGC2. Sand Solutions operates SGC2, an IaaS/PaaS offering, as both the cloud service provider and the managed service provider.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Federal agencies, FedRAMP, and current or prospective customers request access using the Request Access button on the SGC2 Trust Center at https://trust.paramify.com/sandsolutions/sgc2. Sand Solutions reviews each request and grants access to approved requesters.
